notes.title: Open packs of CARDS and grab GUNS to slay ZOMBIES with!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35238896/0489eae7c3c6884218b36bab9a51e9bfdf27fe28.jpg[/img]
[b]CARDS GUNS ZOMBIES[/b] is a roguelike FPS horde defense game mixed with a collectible card game, in which the player tries to survive the longest, slay the most zombies, and save as many citizens as possible each run, using the cards he collects in between tries.

[previewyoutube=-5RshT1hsks;full][/previewyoutube]
Open packs of cards, build your deck, slay zombies, save the citizens, and compete with others on the worldwide leaderboards. Then open some more, change the game with new additions to your collection, and REPEAT!

Check CARDS GUNS ZOMBIES!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3106540/CARDS_GUNS_ZOMBIES

notes.title: Gamers, assemble! We need your support!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/2e02086af27c0bd148e16aff321cbb7d41bec17c.png[/img]

[h3]Don’t adjust your screens and refresh the browsers or Steam clients!  
You’re seeing well, this devlog is about something totally different than usual![/h3]

On the occasion of the ongoing campaign on Kickstarter, we’re helping our brother, [b]Climber: Sky is the Limit[/b], get some well-deserved attention! 


Our studio, together with A2 Softworks, didn’t expect the project to be nominated in 2 categories on such prestige event as [b]gamescom 2021[/b]. Nominations gave us a lot of motivation, and fuel for future development but like in every game cycle, there is a time when developers need some help from their community. 

This time has come for us, that’s why we would like to invite you all to Climber: Sky is the Limit’s campaign on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/climberskyisthelimit/climber-sky-is-the-limit]KICKSTARTER[/url]! 

For the next few weeks on Kickstarter, we’re going to collect funds and feedback from the gamers to polish the game and astonish everyone with its final form! 

At this stage of development, all help is welcomed. That’s why if you can’t (or don’t want to) help us through Kickstarter but you’re willing to support us in any form, even a small action like leaving feedback or adding the game to your wishlist on Steam will help us a million! 


[b]Follow the project’s campaign on Kickstarter and get notified at launch![/b]


[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/climberskyisthelimit/climber-sky-is-the-limit][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40696070/747a63af8f66a33e4aa84f83babfb423941002e6.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: MMS: Prologue is live now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35238896/a22b1747e712f52aa6c1a326bc4f5ac46d710a1d.png[/img]

Fellow Alchemists,

The Prologue version of the other game we, Polyslash, have been working on - [b]Mech Mechanic Simulator[/b], is released and you can get it for [b]free[/b]! 

Compared to the previously available demo version there is an additional, not shown before, mech to fix and a new painting station which you can use to give your mech a more... artistic touch. The in-game jobs are also extended and as before you’ll be able to scan, wash, detach, assemble, weld and de-rust things. These extensions should easily give you [b]more than 1h of gameplay[/b]!

So while you await more information and the release of Chinese version of Alchemist Simulator, why not take a moment and download our Prologue and if you liked it [b]wishlist the main game[/b]! However, if you first want to see how the Mech Mechanic Simulator Prologue looks like, then we will be [b]live streaming today at 7pm GMT[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1485350/Mech_Mechanic_Simulator_Prologue/

notes.title: Patch Notes #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35238896/71b8325b5a3f8efae8f0c214c40ad293a3d7d41e.png[/img]

Fellow Alchemists,

we’re still working on improving our game and now we have great news for you! ːsteamhappyː Another boost is coming to our game, a bunch of things added or fixed to Make Brewing Potions Easier Again…! Or something like that. ːsteamfacepalmː

Here is the list of the fixed bugs and new features:
[list]
[*] processed ingredients don't vanish from the shelf (new feature),
[*] canceling active quest (new feature),
[*] additional pop-up text while selling/returning potion,
[*] added inverted mouse option in the settings,
[*] added VSync toggle option in the settings,
[*] FOV camera fixed on Almanach,
[*] improved delivery box mechanic,
[*] some translation improvements.
[/list]
We're always open to your suggestions, so feel free to contact us if have some idea about what you want to see in Alchemist Simulator! ːsteammockingː

notes.title: Alchemist Simulator Team Wishes You a Spooky Halloween!
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1105040/Alchemist_Simulator/][img]https://i.imgur.com/rAxpEso.gif[/img][/url]

The team is super excited to congratulate you all guys with the upcoming Haloween. A night to be scared and to scare others!

We are all here hard at work on bringing you Alchemist Simulator as soon as possible and very soon we will publish our first dev diary. There are many interesting features that are slowly but surely coming together and we can't wait to get the game into your hands!

Stay tuned and scared!
